goal: Give the Guardian app a data model that can hold everything the three engines report: file scans and detections, quarantined files, enrolled hosts with their host-check findings, CVE exposure, signature feed state, policies, and zig-waf events. Migrations are generated from the models, never written by hand.
scope: Models with defineModel(): Scan (host, target, started/finished, files, bytes, verdict counts, engine and database versions), Detection (scan, path or container path, signature name, source, severity, sha256, action taken), QuarantineItem (detection, stored location, original path, restore and delete state), Host (name, platform, role, enrolment state, agent and database versions, last seen), Finding (host, category, severity, title, remediation, details JSON, first and last seen, suppressed), CveExposure (host, package, ecosystem, installed version, CVE id, CVSS, KEV flag, due date, fixed version), SignatureFeed (name, source, version, last update, coverage summary), Policy (scan surfaces, fail-closed, limits, schedules, suppressions), WafEvent (host, site, rule id, anomaly score, action, client IP, method, path, messages)
Relationships: Host hasMany Scan, Finding, CveExposure, WafEvent; Scan hasMany Detection; Detection hasOne QuarantineItem
useTimestamps on all, useUuid on records exposed through the API, indexes for host plus time queries
Factories for every model so dashboards and tests have realistic data
`buddy generate:migrations`, review, `buddy migrate`
notes: WafEvent mirrors the normalised shape ts-cloud already defines (`WafEvent` in ts-cloud `packages/ts-cloud/src/protection/waf.ts`) so events need no translation
Severity is one enum shared by Detection, Finding and CveExposure so the risk score (P10.12) can combine them
Model rows are read synchronously; keep any set: hook synchronous so writes stay in place (AGENTS.md data layer section)
accept: Migrations generate cleanly from the models and apply on SQLite
`buddy seed` fills every table from the factories
`./buddy typecheck`, `./buddy lint` and `./buddy test` pass

goal: Let hosts (Stacks boxes and desktops) enrol with Guardian once and then report scans, detections, host findings, CVE exposure and WAF events over an authenticated API, idempotently and in batches.
refs: zig-waf `src/api-v1.json` (enrollment-tokens and nodes resources, for naming parity)
scope: Enrolment: an operator creates a single-use enrolment token in Guardian; `POST /api/hosts/enrol` exchanges it for a host id and a long-lived host credential (hashed at rest, rotatable, revocable)

Ingest endpoints for batches: scans with their detections, findings (upsert by host plus stable finding id, so a repeated check updates last seen instead of duplicating), CVE exposure (replace-set per host and inventory run), WAF events (append, deduplicated by an event id)
Heartbeat endpoint carrying agent version, database versions and protection state
Request size limits, per-host rate limits, and validation through the model schemas
OpenAPI output from the routes so the CLI and agent use a typed client
notes: Field names follow zig-waf's node and enrollment resources where they overlap, so a host enrolled in both systems lines up by node id
Uploads of quarantined samples are not part of ingest: hashes and metadata only, samples stay on the host unless an operator asks for one
accept: Feature tests cover enrolment, token reuse refused, revoked credential refused, idempotent replay of every ingest batch
A batch of 10k WAF events ingests in under 2 seconds on SQLite in the test suite
`./buddy test` and `./buddy typecheck` pass

Report model: scan results, detections, host findings and CVE exposure as typed records matching the P10.02 API
Quarantine operations on the local host: move, restore, delete, with an index file
A small typed API client for the Guardian server
notes: No logic duplicated from the engine: severity, verdicts and finding categories come from the engine's JSON output
The package imports everything it uses explicitly; browser auto-imports do not reach workspace modules
accept: Unit tests scan the EICAR file through both the in-process and the socket path and get the same result
Quarantine round trip (move, restore) preserves bytes and mode

goal: A `guardian` command line that does everything an operator needs on a host: scan, watch, run host checks and CVE audits, update signatures, manage quarantine, run the daemon, show status and enrol with a Guardian server.

Flags: `--json` on every command, `--min-severity`, `--exclude`, `--threads`, `--report` (send results to the enrolled server)
Exit codes by severity: 0 clean, 1 suspicious or low, 2 infected or high, 3 critical, 4 error
